messages:
Priya Rao: Quick sync 9 following the last postmortem, proposing a short trial for action SLAs: 7d for a plan (P0/P1), 30d standard close, 90d long-term with approval. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: +1 on clear targets. Suggest we keep a 60d mid bucket for procurement/legal blockers so ops aren't forced to 90d immediately.
Ana Gomez: Ok to split. I'll add a 'SLA_reason' field in the sheet to capture why an action is >30d.
Devon Li: Prefer enforcing 7d for plan across all severities so owners don't sit on tasks. 30d closure sounds good. Approvals for >30d go through SLA Approver.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Plan: 7/30/90 buckets, with exception approval required at 14-day review. Samir, can you propose a lightweight approval flow?
Samir Patel: Simple flow: owner requests extension in the sheet -> SLA Approver gets ping -> Approver either signs off with justification or escalates to Eng Lead. We'll add a timestamped note.
Ana Gomez: I'll build a Google Sheet template: columns = action, owner, created_ts, plan_ts, status, SLA_bucket, SLA_reason, approver, closure_ts, recurrence_flag, related_incident_links. Will share EOD Friday.
Maya (oncall-bot): Reminder: Incident #432 follow-up review scheduled tomorrow.
Devon Li: For recurrence detection, start with same top-level service tag + same error class within 30 days. Weekly digest surfaces recurrence_flag==true.
Priya Rao: Add a monthly 'recurrence retro' to triage systemic issues surfaced by the digest.
Samir Patel: Comms cadence proposal: 48h summary, 7d full draft, 14d follow-up review, 30d closure or escalate. If >30d requested, approver decision at 14d review.
Devon Li: I'll add a simple script to auto-create rows for actions from the postmortem into the sheet and set default SLAs (owner can change with justification).
Ana Gomez: Also will include a small 'status-change' webhook that posts to #eng-oncall when an action moves to 'blocked' or 'approved >30d'.
Priya Rao: Roles to define in the playbook: Postmortem Lead, Action Owner, Remediation Reviewer, SLA Approver. Remediation Reviewer rotates weekly among senior oncallers.
Samir Patel: Add an escalation contact column per action so if an owner misses the 7d plan step we have someone to ping.
Maya (oncall-bot): Scheduled: weekly recurrence digest posts Monday 09:00 PT.
Priya Rao: OK, I'll update the playbook tonight with SLA buckets, role defs, sheet link and cadence. Trial starts next Monday for 1 month. We'll evaluate at the end of the trial and iterate. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: SGTM. :thumbsup:
Ana Gomez: I'll share the sheet draft and automation notes by EOD Friday.
Devon Li: I'll drop the webhook snippet in the thread when ready.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. If no objections, consider this plan approved for the trial. Next check in will be in the first weekly digest after rollout.
